reason: It is not my card and not my call - I run the floor, the owner signs off on anything that recurs, and I am not going to push a monthly subscription when our Tuesday is already dead. We have cancelled software before that nobody opened after a fortnight.
objection: What happens when the internet drops mid-tournament? If the screen freezes halfway through a frame on a Friday I am the one standing in front of forty regulars with no bracket and no scores, and then the argument I was meant to avoid is twice as bad.
would_change_my_mind: Show me it keeps running on the venue's own screen with the connection pulled - bracket and scores still working offline, syncing later - and I will take the free month to the owner myself.
